title: Stop Saying "Very Small": 10 Better Words to Use
description:
Stop saying "very small" and use one of these 10 better English words instead. You get five words for small things and five words for small amounts and small chances. Every word comes with a picture, a clear meaning and an example sentence. After each set of five words, you test yourself with a quick quiz and practise speaking by repeating the example sentences out loud after me.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:10 Small things
1:08 Speaking practice: small things
1:41 Small amounts and chances
2:37 Speaking practice: small amounts and chances
3:15 Your turn

The 10 words
Small things: tiny, minuscule, microscopic, miniature, compact
Small amounts and chances: slight, slim, minimal, negligible, meager

Which word will you use next time? Write it in the comments.

Find another word for any word on anotherwordfor.net
